SASOL PRICES US$750 MILLION GUARANTEED SENIOR UNSECURED CONVERTIBLE
BONDS


Sasol Limited is pleased to announce that Sasol Financing USA LLC, its indirect wholly owned
subsidiary (the "Issuer"), has priced its offering of US$750 million guaranteed senior unsecured
convertible bonds due 2032 (the "2032 Convertible Bonds") (the "Offering").


Capitalised terms used in this announcement but not defined have the meanings given to them in
the terms and conditions of the 2032 Convertible Bonds (the "Conditions").


The net proceeds of the Offering are expected to be used by the Issuer for general corporate
purposes, including, but not limited to: (i) the repurchase invitation made by Sasol Financing
International Limited for the Issuer’s outstanding US$750 million 4.5% guaranteed senior
unsecured convertible bonds due 2027 announced earlier today, 17 November 2026, and (ii) the
refinancing of debt.


The 2032 Convertible Bonds will be issued at 100% of their principal amount in denominations of
US$200,000 each and, unless previously redeemed, converted or purchased and cancelled, will be
redeemed at their principal amount on or around 24 November 2032. The 2032 Convertible Bonds
will pay a coupon of 2.875% per annum, payable semi-annually in arrear and in equal instalments
on 24 May and 24 November of each year, with the first interest payment date on 24 May 2027. All
payments in respect of the 2032 Convertible Bonds will be guaranteed by the Company. The initial
conversion price is US$18.8073, representing a premium of 42.5% to the volume weighted
average price of the Ordinary Shares listed on the main board of JSE Limited between the opening
of trading and pricing today, 17 November 2026, translated into US$ using the USD:ZAR exchange
rate at the time of pricing. The conversion price will be subject to customary anti-dilution
adjustments pursuant to the Conditions, including, among other things, dividends paid by Sasol.
The 2032 Convertible Bonds will be issued by the Issuer on or around 24 November 2026 (the
"Closing Date") and an application is expected to be made for the 2032 Convertible Bonds to be
admitted to trading on the Open Market (Freiverkehr) segment of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange
within 30 days following the Closing Date.
The 2032 Convertible Bonds, subject to the receipt of the requisite approvals at a general meeting
of the shareholders of Sasol (the "Shareholder Resolutions"), will be, during the Conversion Period
(with such Conversion Period starting on 24 November 2031 and otherwise limited to periods
following certain events prior to 24 November 2031 including without limitation, the occurrence of
an event of default, a change of control, a de-listing event or the announcement of certain
significant dividend distributions, as described in the Conditions), convertible into new and/or
existing ordinary shares of Sasol (the “Ordinary Shares”), cash (at the election of the Company), or
a combination thereof, in each case, pursuant to and in accordance with the Conditions. Prior to,
and/or absent such approvals, holders of the 2032 Convertible Bonds will (in accordance with the
Conditions) receive on conversion a cash amount equal to the value of the Ordinary Shares.
The Company will use all reasonable endeavours to convene a general meeting of its shareholders
not later than 14 months after the Closing Date (the "Long Stop Date") for the purpose of, inter alia,
considering, and if thought fit, passing the Shareholder Resolutions.


At any time after the date of the first general meeting of the shareholders of Sasol following the
Closing Date, for so long as the Shareholder Resolutions have not been approved and notice of
such redemption is given to holders of the 2032 Convertible Bonds not later than 10 Johannesburg
business days after the Long Stop Date, the Issuer may elect to redeem all but not some of the
2032 Convertible Bonds at the greater of: (i) 102% of their principal amount, or (ii) 102% of their
fair market value, in each case plus accrued but unpaid interest, all as further described in the
Conditions.


The Issuer will have the option to redeem all but not some of the 2032 Convertible Bonds at their
principal amount (plus accrued but unpaid interest) in accordance with the Conditions (i) at any
time on or after 15 December 2030, if the Parity Value (as defined in the Conditions) is equal to or
exceeds US$260,000 for a specified period of time; or (ii) if at any time 85% or more of the
principal amount of the 2032 Convertible Bonds originally issued have been converted and/or
redeemed and/or purchased and cancelled (all as more fully described in the Conditions). The
2032 Convertible Bonds may also be redeemed at the option of the Issuer at their principal amount
(plus accrued but unpaid interest) following the delivery of a Tax Redemption Notice (as more fully
described in the Conditions), subject to each holder’s right not to be so redeemed and to receive,
thereafter, payments net of withholding.


The 2032 Convertible Bonds may be redeemed at the option of each holder of the 2032
Convertible Bonds at their principal amount (plus accrued but unpaid interest) following the
occurrence of a Relevant Event, a Change of Control or a De-Listing Event (all as more fully
described in the Conditions).


In the context of the Offering, the Company, the Issuer and the Company's other subsidiaries have
agreed to a lock-up relating to equity and equity-related securities for a period commencing on
pricing and ending 90 calendar days following the Closing Date, subject to certain exceptions and
waiver by the Joint Global Coordinators.


BofA Securities and Mizuho acted as Joint Global Coordinators for the Offering. BofA Securities,
Citigroup, J.P. Morgan and Mizuho acted as Joint Bookrunners for the Offering. Intesa Sanpaolo,
MUFG and SMBC acted as Co-Lead Managers for the Offering (together with the Joint Global
Coordinators and Joint Bookrunners, the "Joint Lead Managers").

THIS ANNOUNCEMENT IS FOR INFORMATION PURPOSES ONLY AND DOES NOT

SOLELY FOR THE PURPOSES OF THE PRODUCT GOVERNANCE REQUIREMENTS

THE TARGET MARKET ASSESSMENT IS WITHOUT PREJUDICE TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF
ANY CONTRACTUAL OR LEGAL SELLING RESTRICTIONS IN RELATION TO ANY OFFERING
OF THE 2032 CONVERTIBLE BONDS.


FOR THE AVOIDANCE OF DOUBT, THE TARGET MARKET ASSESSMENT DOES NOT
CONSTITUTE: (A) AN ASSESSMENT OF SUITABILITY OR APPROPRIATENESS FOR THE

GROUP OF INVESTORS TO INVEST IN, OR PURCHASE, OR TAKE ANY OTHER ACTION
WHATSOEVER WITH RESPECT TO THE 2032 CONVERTIBLE BONDS.


THE 2032 CONVERTIBLE BONDS ARE NOT INTENDED TO BE OFFERED, SOLD OR
OTHERWISE MADE AVAILABLE TO AND SHOULD NOT BE OFFERED, SOLD OR OTHERWISE
MADE AVAILABLE TO ANY RETAIL INVESTOR IN THE EEA OR THE UNITED KINGDOM. FOR
THESE PURPOSES, A “RETAIL INVESTOR” MEANS (A) IN THE EEA, A PERSON WHO IS ONE
(OR MORE) OF: (I) A RETAIL CLIENT AS DEFINED IN POINT (11) OF ARTICLE 4(1) OF MIFID II

PROFESSIONAL CLIENT AS DEFINED IN POINT (8) OF ARTICLE 2(1) OF REGULATION (EU)
